facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple struck ten the kitchen clock showed a quarter past ten, and repeats that the clock is kept fast on purpose.
Transcript gives Lina coming down to the kitchen at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock, staying until after the temple struck eleven.
Transcript gives the piano beginning at twelve minutes to eleven and stopping at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Transcript gives the hall clock striking eleven when the kitchen clock showed three minutes past eleven.

added.quote: The dinner was going on, the gentlemen were talking, and I had my work. I did not go up or down. I had my work in the kitchen, and that is where I stayed.
added.why: Rosa's whereabouts during dinner: she claims she never left the kitchen, so she was not upstairs or in the hall at any point while dinner was running.

added.quote: she was very upset, I think, about the master sending her down from the atelier.
added.why: Lina was in the atelier with the master before she came down to the kitchen at 10:37, and the master was alive and sent her down, so the atelier-then-kitchen order and a sighting of the master before 10:37 are new.
